name: spamfilter
description: IMAP spam filter for any IMAP/IDLE-capable mailbox. One thread per account, scores via the companion rspamd container, moves to Junk based on per-account rules, learns Bayes from your own Inbox-Junk moves. Never deletes mail (MOVE only). Per-account config (credentials, modes, threshold) lives in `/mnt/user/appdata/spamfilter/accounts.yml`. Edit that file by hand; container picks it up on restart. Requires the companion containers spamfilter-redis, spamfilter-rspamd, and spamfilter-unbound on the `spamnet` network.

paths.name: accounts.yml
paths.description: Account list and per-account overrides. Must exist before first start. Template at https://github.com/marcelverdult/imap-spamfilter/blob/main/accounts.yml.example

paths.name: State dir
paths.description: SQLite audit DB and heartbeat file. Persists across restarts.

ports.name: Dashboard port
ports.description: Host port for the optional read-only web dashboard. The container always listens on 8080 internally; this maps it to a host port of your choice. The dashboard starts once at least one login user exists. Add a user by running the helper inside the container: docker exec -it spamfilter python dashboard.py - it writes state/dashboard_users. No restart needed; the dashboard re-reads that file on each login.

variables.name: RSPAMD_SCAN_URL
variables.description: rspamd /checkv2 endpoint. Default works with the companion container on the same spamnet network.

variables.name: RSPAMD_LEARN_URL
variables.description: rspamd controller base URL. Used for /learnspam and /learnham.

variables.name: RSPAMD_PASSWORD (override)
variables.description: Leave blank to use the auto-generated value from /state/controller.password (written by bootstrap.sh). Only set this if you want to override.

variables.name: DEFAULT_JUNK_RETENTION_DAYS
variables.description: How many days a message stays in Junk before being MOVED to Trash. 0 disables. Overrides defaults.junk_retention_days in accounts.yml.

variables.name: DEFAULT_TRAINED_RETENTION_DAYS
variables.description: How many days a message stays in Junk/Trained-Spam before being MOVED to Trash. 0 disables. Overrides defaults.trained_retention_days in accounts.yml.

variables.name: STATE_DIR
variables.description: In-container path (matches the State dir mount)

variables.name: DASHBOARD_USERS
variables.description: Optional. Alternative to the state/dashboard_users file (preferred - run docker exec -it spamfilter python dashboard.py). Comma-separated username:hash:scope entries; scope is 'admin' or pipe-separated account names; merges with the file.

variables.name: DASHBOARD_USER (legacy)
variables.description: Legacy single-user login username. Prefer the state/dashboard_users file. Setting this and DASHBOARD_PASSWORD enables the dashboard with one plaintext account.

variables.name: DASHBOARD_PASSWORD (legacy)
variables.description: Legacy single-user login password, paired with DASHBOARD_USER. Prefer the state/dashboard_users file.
